title_en: Deceiving the East, Attacking the West
full_text_zh:
[P1] 声东击西

[P2] 东汉的时候，匈奴人在西域横行霸道。他们经常骑着马，到汉朝边境来烧杀抢掠。边境的百姓，吓得连白天都不敢出城门。班超的父亲和哥哥、妹妹都是史学家，他却一心想上战场杀敌，报效国家。这年，汉明帝派窦固将军攻打匈奴。班超听说后，立即扔下手中的笔，加入窦固将军的军队，一起奔赴西域。

[P3] 班超作战时有勇有谋，立下不少战功。有一天，窦固将军对他说："西域三十六国，就像匈奴人的左膀右臂，你愿不愿意出使西域，说服他们归顺我汉朝？"班超立刻领命："将军，我愿意出使西域，扬我汉朝天威！"

[P4] 于是，班超挑选出三十六名勇士，组成汉朝使团。不久后，他就带着使团，向西域出发了。

[P5] 汉朝使团到达的第一个西域国家，是鄯善国。
鄯善王早就听说汉朝兵强马壮了。如今得到汉朝使团要来的消息，他一大早就派人去迎接了。

[P6] 班超拜见了鄯善王，恭敬地说："尊敬的大王，我们汉朝的皇帝派我来，是希望和您共同对付匈奴。我们都吃过匈奴人的苦头，应该联合起来共同抗敌，这样匈奴才不敢再猖狂呀！"鄯善王听了连连点头："说得太对了！你们远道而来，辛苦了！请先住下来，抵抗匈奴的事，我敬过两天再商议。"

[P7] 说完，鄯善王请汉朝使团住进了贵宾馆，每天好酒好菜地招待他们。可是没过几天，端上桌的菜越来越少，鄯善王也不肯见班超了。班超心里打起了鼓：‘为什么鄯善王突然变了脸，是不是匈奴的使团也来了？’

[P8] 这天，吃晚饭的时候，等上完菜，班超叫住了鄯善国的侍卫官，故意问他："匈奴使团来了好几天了吧，他们住在哪里呀？"侍卫官吓了一大跳，以为匈奴使团来到鄯善国的消息泄露了，只好回答说："匈奴使者住在他们自己的营地里。"

[P9] 班超将侍卫官捆起来藏好，随后马上召集勇士们商议："匈奴使团一来，鄯善王就不见我们了。如果他把我们交给匈奴人，那可怎么办？"三十六名勇士都请班超出主意。班超说："不进老虎洞，怎么抓得住小老虎呢！今天夜里，我们就闯进匈奴使团这个老虎洞，让他们尝尝我们的厉害！"

[P10] 到了半夜，班超和三十六名勇士背着战鼓，拿着弓，悄悄摸到了匈奴使团的营地外。十个人带鼓藏在营地后方，二十六个人持弓守在营地大门外。班超独自潜入匈奴使团的营地内，乘着风势放了一把火。火光亮起，营地后方的十个人把战鼓擂得咚咚响，他们齐声呐喊，好像有千军万马冲杀过来。

[P11] 匈奴使团以为是敌人来进攻，顾不上穿衣服就往外逃。谁承想刚冲到大门口，一阵箭雨就“唰唰”地飞过来，匈奴使者一个都没有逃出去。第二天，鄯善王听说匈奴使者全死了，吓破了胆，赶紧和汉朝结了盟。

[P12] 收服鄯善国之后，于阗国和许多西域小国也归附了汉朝，可是，莎车国却联合龟兹、温宿等几个小国，要与汉军打到底。
于是，班超带领着于阗等国的军队共两万五千人，准备进攻莎车国。
龟兹国和温宿国也集合了五万人，赶去支援莎车国。

[P13] 班超把将领们叫到营帐里说："我们兵力这么少，怎么打得过那五万人？还是先撤退吧！于阗国的军队往东走，剩下的人跟我往西走，今天夜里鼓声一响就出发。"一名龟兹俘虏就被绑在营帐外，晚上他磨断绳子逃回去，把这个消息报告给了龟兹王。

[P14] 龟兹王兴冲冲地点了一万骑兵，赶往西边追杀班超；温宿王率领八千人马，赶往东边拦截于阗王。可是，从半夜一直追到天大亮，龟兹王却连班超的影子也没见到。这时候，一名满头大汗的传令兵从后面骑马跑过来，大叫道：‘大王，不好了，班超打进莎车国了！’这是怎么回事呢？

[P15] 原来，班超早就和于阗王约定好，走出不到十里路，就悄悄找了个山谷藏起来。等到龟兹王领着骑兵飞驰而过，班超就带兵杀回莎车国。
公鸡打鸣天放亮，班超和于阗王两路人马如同神兵天降，一起向莎车国发起了进攻。莎车国内惊慌大乱，不久就打开城门投降了。

[P16] 班超故意放出假消息，让龟兹王以为他们想逃跑，带着骑兵追出去。确认龟兹王追远后，他杀了个回马枪，挥师打败了莎车国。这种先制造假象把敌人引开，再来攻打的计策，就叫“声东击西”。班超足智多谋，在西域纵横三十多年，收服了西域三十六国，被封为“定远侯”，终于实现了报效国家的心愿。
full_text_en:
[P1] Create a diversion to the east, attack to the west.

[P2] During the Eastern Han Dynasty, the Xiongnu roamed freely and tyrannically in the Western Regions. They often rode horses to the Han Dynasty's borders to burn, kill, and loot. The people on the frontier were so frightened that they dared not leave the city gates even during the day. Ban Chao's father, elder brother, and sister were all historians, but he dreamed of going to the battlefield to fight enemies and serve his country. That year, Emperor Ming of Han sent General Dou Gu to attack the Xiongnu. Upon hearing the news, Ban Chao immediately threw down his pen, joined General Dou Gu's army, and rushed together to the Western Regions.

[P3] Ban Chao was brave and strategic in battle, achieving many military successes. One day, General Dou Gu said to him: "The thirty-six kingdoms of the Western Regions are like the left arm and right arm of the Xiongnu. Would you be willing to be sent to the Western Regions to persuade them to submit to our Han dynasty?" Ban Chao immediately accepted the mission: "General, I am willing to be sent to the Western Regions and uphold the might of the Han dynasty!"

[P4] Thus, Ban Chao selected thirty-six brave warriors to form a Han dynasty delegation. Soon after, he set off with the delegation toward the Western Regions.

[P5] The first Western Regions country the Han dynasty delegation reached was Shanshan Kingdom.
King Shanshan had long heard that the Han army was strong and powerful. Upon receiving news that the Han delegation was coming, he sent people to greet them early in the morning.

[P6] Ban Chao bowed to the King of Shanshan and respectfully said: "Your Majesty, the Emperor of the Han Dynasty has sent me here, hoping to join forces with you to fight against the Xiongnu. We have all suffered from the Xiongnu's cruelty. We should unite and fight together, so that the Xiongnu will dare not be reckless anymore!" The King of Shanshan nodded repeatedly: "You're absolutely right! You've traveled a long way, you must be tired! Please stay here for now. We'll discuss the matter of resisting the Xiongnu in two days."

[P7] After that, the King of Shanshan invited the Han Dynasty delegation to stay in the guesthouse, treating them with fine wine and delicious food every day. But after a few days, the food served at the table became less and less, and the King of Shanshan refused to meet Ban Chao. Ban Chao began to worry: 'Why has the King of Shanshan suddenly changed his attitude? Could it be that the envoys from the Xiongnu have also arrived?'

[P8] That day, during dinner, after the dishes were served, Ban Chao stopped the guard officer of Shanshan Kingdom and deliberately asked him: "The Xiongnu envoys have been here for several days, haven't they? Where are they staying?" The guard officer was greatly startled, thinking the news of the Xiongnu envoys' arrival in Shanshan had been leaked, and could only reply: "The Xiongnu envoys are staying in their own camp."

[P9] Ban Chao tied up the guard and hid him, then immediately gathered his brave warriors to discuss: "As soon as the Xiongnu envoys arrived, the King of Shanshan stopped seeing us. What if he hands us over to the Xiongnu?" All thirty-six warriors asked Ban Chao for advice. Ban Chao said: "How can you catch a little tiger without entering the tiger's den? Tonight, we'll storm into the Xiongnu envoys' den and show them our strength!"

[P10] At midnight, Ban Chao and thirty-six brave warriors, carrying war drums and bows, quietly approached the camp of the Xiongnu envoys. Ten of them hid with drums behind the camp, while twenty-six held bows at the camp's main gate. Ban Chao sneaked into the Xiongnu envoys' camp alone and set a fire with the wind. As the flames lit up, the ten men behind the camp beat their drums loudly, and they shouted together, making it seem as if thousands of troops were charging in.

[P11] The Xiongnu envoys thought enemies were attacking and rushed out without even putting on their clothes. Who knew that as soon as they reached the gate, a rain of arrows “swish-swish” flew over, and not a single Xiongnu envoy managed to escape. The next day, the King of Shanshan, hearing that all the Xiongnu envoys were dead, was terrified and quickly formed an alliance with the Han Dynasty.

[P12] After subduing the Shanshan Kingdom, the Yutian Kingdom and many other small Western Regions states also submitted to the Han Dynasty. However, the Shache Kingdom allied with the Qiuci and Wensu kingdoms, determined to fight the Han army to the end.
Thus, Ban Chao led an army of 25,000 troops from Yutian and other states, preparing to attack the Shache Kingdom.
The Qiuci and Wensu kingdoms also gathered 50,000 troops to rush to support Shache.

[P13] Ban Chao called the generals to the tent and said: "Our forces are so small, how can we defeat those fifty thousand men? Let's retreat first! The army of Yutian will go east, and the rest of us will follow me west. We'll set out as soon as the drums sound tonight." A captured Kushan prisoner was tied outside the tent. That night, he sawed through his ropes and escaped, reporting this news to the King of Kushan.

[P14] The King of Qiuci hastily assembled 10,000 cavalrymen and rushed westward to pursue Ban Chao; the King of Wensu led 8,000 troops eastward to intercept the King of Yutian. However, from midnight until dawn, the King of Qiuci couldn't even catch a glimpse of Ban Chao. At that moment, a messenger, drenched in sweat, galloped up from behind and shouted: 'Your Majesty, trouble! Ban Chao has broken into the kingdom of Shache!' What on earth is going on?

[P15] Originally, Ban Chao had already made an agreement with King Yutian. After traveling less than ten li, they secretly hid in a valley. When King Qiuci led his cavalry galloping past, Ban Chao led his troops back to attack the state of Shache.
At dawn, when the rooster crowed, Ban Chao and King Yutian's two armies descended like heavenly soldiers, launching a joint attack on Shache. The state of Shache fell into panic and chaos, and soon opened its gates to surrender.

[P16] Ban Chao deliberately spread false information, making the King of Qiuci believe they were trying to flee, so he led his cavalry in pursuit. After confirming the King of Qiuci had gone far, he launched a surprise counterattack and defeated the state of Shache. This strategy of creating a false impression to lure the enemy away before attacking is called "deceiving the east to strike the west." Ban Chao, wise and resourceful, roamed the Western Regions for over thirty years, subduing thirty-six states, was enfeoffed as the "Marquis of the Far West," and finally fulfilled his aspiration of serving his country.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页标题为‘声东击西’，配有一名身穿古装、手持长剑的男子插图，暗示该成语故事的开端。
[P2] 本页讲述了东汉时期匈奴在西域作乱，边境百姓深受其害，而班超虽出身史学世家，却立志投笔从戎，加入窦固将军的军队奔赴西域的故事。
[P3] 本页描述了班超在军中立下战功后，窦固将军任命他出使西域，班超欣然接受任务，立志扬汉朝威仪。
[P4] 班超挑选三十六名勇士组成使团，并带领他们向西域出发。
[P5] 本页描述汉朝使团抵达西域的第一个国家鄯善国，鄯善王因早闻汉朝军力强盛，特意派人迎接使团。
[P6] 班超拜见鄯善王，提出联合抗击匈奴的建议，鄯善王表示赞同并邀请使团暂住，约定两天后再商议抗敌事宜。
[P7] 班超发现鄯善王对汉朝使团的态度突然冷淡，饭菜减少且不再接见，他怀疑匈奴使团可能已抵达鄯善国，内心开始担忧。
[P8] 班超在鄯善国用餐时，故意询问侍卫官匈奴使团的下落，试探对方态度，侍卫官惊慌失措，透露匈奴使者住在营地，证实了班超的怀疑。
[P9] 班超发现鄯善王态度突变后，将侍卫官藏起，召集三十六名勇士商议对策，决定夜袭匈奴使团，以绝后患。
[P10] 班超带领三十六名勇士夜袭匈奴使团营地，利用火攻和鼓声制造声势，制造千军万马突袭的假象。
[P11] 班超带领三十六名勇士夜袭匈奴使团营地，用火攻和箭雨将匈奴使者全部歼灭，鄯善王得知后惊恐万分，立即与汉朝结盟。
[P12] 班超在收服鄯善国后，于阗等国归附汉朝，但莎车国联合龟兹、温宿等国对抗汉军。班超率两万五千人准备进攻莎车，而龟兹和温宿也集结五万人支援莎车，战事一触即发。
[P13] 班超在战前召集将领商议撤退计划，将部队分为两路，同时一名龟兹俘虏趁夜逃脱，将汉军的计划泄露给了龟兹王。
[P14] 龟兹王和温宿王分兵追击班超和于阗王，但一无所获，此时一名传令兵报告班超已攻入莎车国，引发龟兹王的惊疑。
[P15] 班超与于阗王按计划在山谷埋伏，待龟兹王军队经过后，突然杀回莎车国，两军合力进攻，莎车国惊慌失措，很快开城投降。
[P16] 本页总结了班超运用‘声东击西’之计击败莎车国，并回顾了他纵横西域、收服三十六国、被封为‘定远侯’的功绩，表达了他报效国家的心愿得以实现。
